info.name: API Reference Associated Persons Contribution Reports API

params.name: employer_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the employer for filtering reports

params.name: status
params.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `open`, `finalized`.

params.name: month
params.description: Month for filtering reports, used together with `year` (MM format)

params.name: year
params.description: Year for filtering reports, can be used standalone or with `month` (YYYY format)

params.name: external_customer_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the customer for EoR platforms, used to filter reports for a logical employer

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs: Returns a list of `contribution reports`. The reports are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recent reports appearing first.

This endpoint finalizes the `contribution report` object, making it immutable and preventing any further updates. Once finalized, its `status` changes to `finalized`, and it serves as a historical record for payroll reporting. Any changes or adjustments that occur after the finalization will roll into the next reporting period.
Returns the `employee breakdown` for a `contribution report`.
